decisions.reason: As a highly related accessory that reinforces the firm's core track-lighting and easy-installation know-how, this adapter is something the firm can readily improve and integrate into its established system business despite limited later web prominence.

Although close to the core range, this LED luminaire shows only weak early visibility and is easier to replace with stronger or newer lighting lines, so management would likely redeploy resources within the broader luminaire portfolio.

The home automation server box is related but somewhat farther from the firm's strongest lighting competences, and the sparse market evidence suggests the firm may not have built enough product-specific learning to justify continued commitment.

A luminaire family sits squarely in the firm's established premium lighting knowledge base and its dedicated product presentation suggests enough initial strategic importance to keep refining and selling it.

An LED luminaire family matches the firm's core technical and design capabilities, and in a growing innovative lighting market the firm has strong absorptive capacity to adapt and commercialise such products.

An LED spotlight series is tightly aligned with the firm's existing lighting engineering, modular presentation, and installer channels, making it a product the firm is well placed to learn from and sustain.
